name: cfcmt-bus-fresh-confirmation-v1

evaluation.test_separation: Three newly predefined Poisson demand/SUMO realizations, disjoint seeds from target collection, smoke and prior test; same fixed timetable, OD intensities and generated route corridors.
evaluation.comparison: Source9, local9, rule3 actual new evaluations; three demand realizations and three training seeds. Do not count reused rule references as nine independent baselines or pool prior cases.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

checkpoint_rule: Reuse all six existing exported adapted policy.pt artifacts without changes; previously verified equal to the original final adapted actors. No checkpoint/seed selection.
intervention: No additional method change. Freeze the execution-space projection and all six existing55k adapted actors before generating or observing the fresh test cases.
primary_comparisons: source versus matched fresh local route
secondary_comparison: local route versus fresh strong rule
analysis: Equal-weight mean across all three cases and all three training seeds; also report each seed and each paired case, wait/ride, completion and executed holding. Keep all outcomes. Old cases remain separate diagnostic history.
boundary: Source/local share55k total historical updates but different target exposure; neither actor used model TD or confidence continuation. This tests initialization-route benefit with the fixed corrected interface.
limits: Only one corridor city, the same pinned2026-05-19 timetable and generated OD intensities. New random realizations are not three measured real days or new cities.
Three reused baseline trajectories support nine paired comparisons per learned route, not nine independent baseline runs.
No checkpoint, seed, floor, threshold, hyperparameter, city or model selection after seeing fresh outcomes.
This is not a physical sim-to-real or normalized-confidence efficacy test.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen runtime and inputs only; no mutable Thesis access; no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
